about: Every voice and clip the app can play, with its licence and review status. Quran recitation, story narration, instructions and sound effects are separate categories and never share a voice. Quran recitation is only ever a human recording from an identified reciter; text-to-speech and pitch changes are never used for it.

licence.note: EveryAyah states no licence. Usage rights must be confirmed with the rights holder before release, or the files replaced with licensed audio.

verification.note: Human recitation streamed per ayah. Not yet checked ayah by ayah against the KFGQPC Hafs text by a recitation specialist for this app.

licence.note: No licensed child-reciter recordings have been supplied. This entry stays switched off until recordings, written permission and a specialist review are in place.

verification.note: Needs a recitation specialist to check every ayah against the KFGQPC Hafs text.

narrators.name: Young voice (this device)
narrators.note: Uses the speech voices built into the device: a child's voice when the device has one, otherwise the most natural voice it has, lifted to sound younger. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. Sound quality depends on the device.

licence.note: Built-in device voices; no audio is shipped.

narrators.name: Child narrator, recorded (not supplied yet)
narrators.note: Recorded narration for every line in narration-lines.json, by a licensed child voice actor or a voice provider whose terms permit this use. Until clips exist, lines fall back to the device voice.
